# Rivera - Câmara de Santa Cruz Cabralia

> A comprehensive calendar resource portal offering printable academic calendars, school district schedules, event calendars, and calendar utilities for educational institutions and organizations across the United States.

This site aggregates printable calendar resources including academic calendars from universities (UAH, UIS, ISU, Rice University), school district schedules (Plano ISD, ISD 423), specialized event calendars (OU Football, Central Park NYC Events, NJ MileSplit), and utility guides for calendar management. The collection spans multiple years and formats to serve students, educators, and event planners.

## University Academic Calendars

- [Uah Fall 2024 Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/uah-fall-2024-calendar.html): UAH fall 2024 academic calendar with class schedule and exam dates
- [Uis Fall 2024 Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/uis-fall-2024-calendar.html): UIS fall 2024 academic calendar with registration and exam deadlines
- [Isu Academic Calendar 2024 - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/isu-academic-calendar-2024.html): ISU 2024 academic calendar with semester dates and registration
- [Rice University Calendar 2024 - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/rice-university-calendar-2024.html): Rice University 2024 academic calendar with semester schedules

## School District Calendars

- [Plano Isd 2026-2026 Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/plano-isd-2026-2026-calendar.html): Plano ISD 2025-2026 school calendar for Texas district scheduling
- [Isd 423 Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/isd-423-calendar.html): ISD 423 school district 2024-2025 academic calendar guide

## Specialized Event & Schedule Calendars

- [2026 Usps Color Coded Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/2026-usps-color-coded-calendar.html): USPS color-coded 2026 calendar for postal letter carrier schedules
- [Nj Milesplit Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/nj-milesplit-calendar.html): New Jersey MileSplit track and field event calendar with meet schedule
- [Central Park New York Events Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/central-park-new-york-events-calendar.html): Central Park NYC events calendar with concerts and activities
- [Ou Football Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/ou-football-calendar.html): University of Oklahoma 2025 football schedule with kickoff times

## General Monthly & Yearly Calendars

- [October 24 Calendar - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/october-24-calendar.html): Printable October 2024 calendar with US holidays and moon phases
- [Show Calendar For November 2025 - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/show-calendar-for-november-2025.html): Printable November 2025 calendar in landscape/portrait PDF format
- [12 Mo Calendar 2024 - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/12-mo-calendar-2024.html): Free printable 2024 12-month calendar with federal holidays

## Developer Resources & Utilities

- [Java Calendar Util - Printable](https://rivera.camaradesantacruzcabralia.ba.gov.br/en/java-calendar-util.html): Java Calendar class utility guide for date-time manipulation
